title: Two big questions I'd like answered this preseason: 1) What kind of depth do the Bucs have at cornerback? Injuries have been such an issue and still are with Benjamin Morrison not fully practicing yet (hamstring) and Zyon McCollum suffering a groin injury. And 2) I wanna see outside linebacker David Walker's trajectory. We have a good idea of what they're getting in Rueben Bain, Jr. and Al-Quadin Muhammad. But Walker, their fourth-round pick from last year, had nine would-be sacks in nine straight training camp practices after suffering a torn ACL in last year's camp. I want to see him against different competition and see how his size continues to hold up.

But Walker, their fourth-round pick from last year, had nine would-be sacks in nine straight training camp practices after suffering a torn ACL in last year's camp. I want to see him against different competition and see how his size continues to hold up.
